name: blacksheep-deterministic-message-completion-5445
instr:
Give every Message a deterministic completion scope so deferred work runs exactly once at the true end of protocol activity. Completion ownership and outcomes must remain coherent across server dispatch, streaming, WebSockets, middleware, sessions, controllers, and outbound requests without changing established wire behavior.

Completion is an atomic, inspectable settlement: synchronous and asynchronous callbacks run once in reverse registration order, including callbacks added during settlement, while concurrent callers receive the same immutable result. Callback failures never stop settlement and appear as CompletionCallbackError values in occurrence order; cancellation of a completion caller does not leave settlement partial. Ownership transfers once, and any repeated transfer raises CompletionOwnershipError without invoking or moving callbacks. HTTP, ServerSentEventsResponse, and WebSocket settle only at their actual terminal protocol boundary, preserving transport, provider, handler, disconnect-code, and cancellation causes while avoiding duplicate sends or closes. ServerSentEventsResponse settles only after provider exhaustion, provider failure, send failure, or cancellation; provider failure remains its cause, and cancellation closes the active provider before settlement finishes. Dispatch, nested middleware, session persistence, normalized asynchronous generators, and controller lifetimes retain ownership and resources until delivery finishes, with cleanup completed a
